jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As a Product Manager, you will own key areas of Sarj’s product portfolio. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, and Operations teams to understand customer needs, define what we build and why, and drive products from concept to launch.

What You’ll Do

  • Own and drive the product roadmap for key areas of the platform.

  • Translate customer needs and business goals into clear product requirements and priorities.

  • Work closely with Engineering and Product Design to scope, prioritize, and ship features.

  • Define success metrics and use data and insights to inform product decisions.

  • Conduct user research and competitive analysis across the Saudi and MENA markets.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to drive successful product launches and iterations.

What We're Looking For

  • 4+ years of Product Management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS, communications, or AI.

  • Excellent communication skills in both English and Arabic.

  • Understanding of the Saudi market and local user needs.

  • Experience taking products or features from 0 to 1 in a startup environment.

  • Strong analytical skills and a data-driven approach to decision-making.

  • Technical fluency with the ability to work effectively with Engineering teams.

  • Strong understanding of customer needs and product development principles.



Why Join Us?

  • Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.

  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.

  • Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

jobs.title: Quality Assurance Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As a Quality Assurance Intern, you'll work closely with our engineering and product teams to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our products. You'll contribute to testing processes, identifying bugs, and improving product quality across various stages of development. This is an opportunity to gain hands-on experience in QA practices within a high-growth AI start-up environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Assist in designing, developing, and executing test plans and test cases

  • Perform manual and automated testing to ensure product quality

  • Identify, document, and track bugs and issues using appropriate tools

  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to resolve defects

  • Participate in regression, functional, and performance testing

  • Help improve QA processes, testing frameworks, and best practices

  • Support release cycles by validating features before deployment

  • Contribute to documentation of test cases, results, and QA procedures

Requirements

  • Final semester or recent university graduate in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Interest in software quality assurance, testing, and AI technologies

  • Basic understanding of software testing concepts and methodologies

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and analytical abilities

  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to speak and write fluently in both Arabic & English

  • Familiarity with testing tools or programming languages is a plus

  • Based in KSA, preferably Riyadh

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up

  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

  • Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products

  • Exposure to real-world QA processes and modern testing tools

jobs.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 
 

Role Overview

We're looking for a people driven Talent Acquisition Specialist to join our team. We believe that the right hire can make all the difference and your mission is to find the best people to help drive our mission forward. As an ambassador of our culture, you'll also ensure all candidates have a 10/5 experience from start to finish.

What You’ll Do:

 

  • Own the full-cycle recruitment process for technical and non-technical roles

  • Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and ideal candidate profiles

  • Source & engage top talent across a variety of channels

  • Screen, interview, and guide candidates through the recruitment process ensuring a 10/5 candidate experience.

  • Track and report on key hiring metrics to continuously improve the process

  • Share timely updates with hire managers on active roles

What we're looking for

  • 2+ years of hands-on recruiting experience, ideally in tech or startups

  • Solid experience sourcing technical talent (engineering, product, etc)

  • Strong communication skills in English and Arabic

  • Familiarity with ATS systems and recruiting tools

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, growing start-up environment

jobs.title: Agent Engineering Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As an Agent Engineering Intern, you will work closely with our engineering, product, and client-facing teams to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve real-world problems. You'll support Proof of Concept (POC) development, own the end-to-end delivery of agent implementations, and interface directly with clients — gaining hands-on experience in one of the most in-demand areas of modern AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of Proof of Concepts (POCs) for new client use cases, from scoping through to demo-ready delivery.

  • Design and build AI agents using our platform, translating client requirements into functional agent workflows.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of agent implementations — taking responsibility for timelines, quality, and outcomes.

  • Interface with clients to gather requirements, present progress, answer questions, and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Listen to recorded calls between AI agents and customers, evaluating each interaction for accuracy, tone, compliance, and customer experience.

  • Score conversations against a defined quality rubric and document findings in our QA tracking system.

  • Flag agent errors, hallucinations, missed customer cues, and policy or compliance issues for the team to address.

  • Identify patterns and trends across calls — recurring failure modes, common customer questions, and opportunities to improve agent prompts and workflows.

  • •Partner with the Operations team to share feedback that informs agent training, prompt updates, and product improvements.

  • Help refine and evolve the QA rubric and scoring guidelines as our agents grow and change.

  • Contribute to weekly quality reports summarizing performance metrics, key issues, and recommended improvements.

  • Occasionally review chat or text-based agent transcripts in addition to voice calls.

Requirements

  • Final semester or recent university graduate in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

  • Interest in software quality assurance, testing, and AI technologies

  • Basic understanding of software testing concepts and methodologies

  • Familiarity with testing tools or programming languages is a plus

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and analytical abilities

  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to speak and write fluently in both Arabic & English

  • Must be based in Riyadh

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up

  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

  • Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products

jobs.title: Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

 

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 

Role Overview

 

As a Graphic Designer, you will have the opportunity to shape our visual brand identity across multiple platforms. You will work closely with cross-functional teams including marketing, product, and engineering, translating ideas into impactful designs. In this role, you’ll create compelling digital assets, contribute to product and campaign visual strategies, and help grow our brand presence in the AI and technology space.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Design graphics, illustrations, and visual assets to support marketing campaigns, product launches, and brand communications.

  • Collaborate with team members to conceptualize creative solutions that effectively communicate our message.

  • Ensure all designs adhere to our established brand guidelines.

  • Participate in brainstorming sessions to develop new design concepts and strategies.

  • Prepare and deliver production-ready art for digital and print platforms.

  • Support the continual evolution of the company’s visual identity as our product suite and market presence grow.

 

Requirements

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Arts, or a related field.

  • Proven experience in graphic design, preferably in a start-up or fast-paced environment.

  • Proficient in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and other relevant design tools.

  • Strong portfolio showcasing creative design work and attention to detail.

  • Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills.

  • Fluency in both Arabic and English

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.

  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.

  • Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

 

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 

Role Overview

 

As a Sales Development Representative, you’ll help grow Sarj’s client base across Saudi Arabia by generating and qualifying opportunities across enterprise and government accounts.

You’ll own outbound prospecting, manage inbound leads, build relationships with key decision-makers, and create qualified opportunities that progress into POCs and signed contracts. You’ll work closely with our Customer Experience, Operations, and Product teams.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Generate and qualify pipeline across enterprise and government accounts.

  • Build and manage target account lists across key sectors including banking, fintech, telecom, retail, healthcare, real estate, and government.

  • Run tailored outreach via email, LinkedIn, phone, and WhatsApp in Arabic and English.

  • Engage decision-makers across Customer Experience, IT, Digital Transformation, and Procurement.

  • Conduct discovery calls and qualify opportunities.

  • Support POCs, follow-ups, and successful handoffs to relevant teams.

  • Represent Sarj at industry, customer experience, financial-sector, and government events.

  • Track pipeline, maintain accurate CRM records, and continuously improve messaging and sales processes.

 

Requirements

 

  • 3–6 years of sales development or business development experience, including 2+ years with enterprise or government accounts.

  • Native Arabic speaker with a Saudi dialect and professional English.

  • Proven experience generating self-sourced pipeline.

  • Strong understanding of sales, lead qualification, and the Saudi enterprise/government landscape.

  • Comfortable discussing integrations, APIs, telephony, and CRM systems.

  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and negotiation skills.

  • Organized and experienced with CRM and sales tools.

Nice To Have

  • Experience selling SaaS, AI, or contact center solutions.

  • Experience with government procurement in KSA.

  • Existing relationships in banking, telecom, or government.

  • Startup or early-stage commercial experience.

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.

  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.

  • Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

 

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 
 

Role Overview

 

As a Content Lead, you will own and manage Sarj AI’s content end-to-end — from strategy and planning to creation and publishing. You’ll work closely with marketing, product, and sales teams to develop compelling content that communicates our brand, products, and ideas across multiple channels.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Own and execute the content strategy across website, social media, blogs, ads, case studies, and video scripts.

  • Develop clear, engaging content that simplifies complex AI and technology concepts.

  • Plan and manage the content calendar and oversee content from ideation to publishing.

  • Collaborate with marketing, product, and sales teams to align content with business objectives.

  • Maintain a consistent brand voice across all channels and formats.

  • Track content performance and use insights to improve future content.

 

Requirements

 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Languages, Communications, or a related field.

  • Exceptional English and Arabic writing and editing skills.

  • Ability to develop and manage content strategy end-to-end, with experience across multiple digital channels and formats.

  • A strong portfolio showcasing creative content work and attention to detail.

  • Strong understanding of social media, digital content, and emerging content trends.

  • Ability to simplify complex AI, technology, and business concepts into engaging content.

  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects, meet deadlines, and work effectively cross-functionally.

  • Video shooting and editing skills are a bonus.

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.

  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.

  • Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

As a Brand and Community Lead, you will own and grow Sarj AI’s brand and community presence, leading events, exhibitions, meetups, media, PR, and community collaborations that connect our company, products, and people with the wider AI ecosystem.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

 

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 

Role Overview

 

As a Product Engineer, you will work closely with the Sales, Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to understand client requirements, design and build tailored solutions, and bring them to life using Sarj AI’s products and capabilities. You will own the solution journey end to end — from understanding the client’s needs and proposing the right approach, to building, integrating, demonstrating, iterating, and handing over the solution to the team after signing.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Partner with Sales to understand client requirements and desired outcomes.

  • Propose how Sarj AI can address client needs and translate requirements into practical, creative solutions.

  • Design, build, and integrate tailored solutions using Sarj AI products and technologies.

  • Prepare and deliver client demos, answering product, technical, and scope-related questions.

  • Gather feedback and iterate on solutions based on client requirements.

  • Coordinate with Product and Engineering when deeper technical input or product capabilities are needed.

  • Hand over signed projects with the relevant solution details and requirements.

  • Build websites and lightweight tools using modern AI-assisted and vibe-coding approaches.

 

Requirements

 

  • 1+ year of experience in Product, Engineering, Business Analysis, or a similar role, preferably in a technology or startup environment.

  • Excellent Arabic and English communication skills, with fluency in the Saudi dialect.

  • Strong problem-solving skills and a creative approach to building solutions.

  • Ability to take ownership of projects end to end.

  • Comfortable working directly with clients and presenting solutions.

  • Strong interest in AI and emerging technologies.

Nice to Have

Experience with the following:

  • APIs, integrations, or low-code/no-code tools.

  • Building prototypes, websites, or internal tools using AI-assisted coding.

  • Solutions, consulting, pre-sales, or other client-facing technical roles.

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up.

  • Work in a collaborative, mission-driven culture with hands-on exposure to innovative AI products.

  • Take ownership, grow, and make a real impact through real-world challenges.

jobs.title: Agent Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

Role Overview

As an Agent Engineer, you will work closely with our engineering, product, and client-facing teams to design, build, and deploy AI agents that solve real-world problems. You'll support Proof of Concept (POC) development, own the end-to-end delivery of agent implementations, and interface directly with clients — gaining hands-on experience in one of the most in-demand areas of modern AI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the development of Proof of Concepts (POCs) for new client use cases, from scoping through to demo-ready delivery.

  • Design and build AI agents using our platform, translating client requirements into functional agent workflows.

  • Own end-to-end delivery of agent implementations — taking responsibility for timelines, quality, and outcomes.

  • Interface with clients to gather requirements, present progress, answer questions, and manage expectations throughout the project lifecycle.

  • Listen to recorded calls between AI agents and customers, evaluating each interaction for accuracy, tone, compliance, and customer experience.

  • Score conversations against a defined quality rubric and document findings in our QA tracking system.

  • Flag agent errors, hallucinations, missed customer cues, and policy or compliance issues for the team to address.

  • Identify patterns and trends across calls — recurring failure modes, common customer questions, and opportunities to improve agent prompts and workflows.

  • •Partner with the Operations team to share feedback that informs agent training, prompt updates, and product improvements.

  • Help refine and evolve the QA rubric and scoring guidelines as our agents grow and change.

  • Contribute to weekly quality reports summarizing performance metrics, key issues, and recommended improvements.

  • Occasionally review chat or text-based agent transcripts in addition to voice calls.

Requirements

  • Basic understanding of software testing concepts and methodologies

  • Familiarity with testing tools or programming languages is a plus

  • Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills

  • Excellent communication and analytical abilities

  • Eagerness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment

  • Ability to speak and write fluently in both Arabic & English

  • Must be based in Riyadh

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up

  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

  • Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products

jobs.title: AI Deployment Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

 

Built with 💜 in KSA and leveraging Silicon Valley expertise, we’re creating innovative solutions in the realm of Voice AI and AI agents. As we continue our rapid growth trajectory in an exciting and dynamic market, we’re looking for A-players to join our team.

 

Role Overview

 

As an AI deployment lead , you'll sit at the intersection of our customers, product, and engineering teams, owning the delivery of solutions from initial requirements through deployment. You’ll work closely with customers to understand their needs, translate them into clear technical requirements, and ensure our teams deliver outstanding results. This role is about more than just keeping projects on track, it’s about managing expectations, solving problems, and exercising sound judgment under pressure.

 

Key Responsibilities

 

  • Work with customers to identify high-impact problems and define AI-driven product features to address them.

  • Convert customer requirements into clear technical specifications and use cases for internal teams.

  • Oversee sprints and project timelines, ensuring timely and high-quality solution delivery.

  • Serve as the bridge between customers and internal teams including data scientists, engineers, and product leads.

  • Build trusted relationships and ensure the long-term success of deployed solutions.
    Own customer delivery as the primary point of contact throughout implementation, ensuring expectations, timelines, and outcomes are clearly managed.

  • Manage difficult conversations with demanding stakeholders, especially when requirements, timelines, or expectations need to be challenged.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in a customer-facing role involving technical delivery, implementation, consulting, solutions engineering, technical account management, or a similar function.

  • Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts, data workflows, and model deployment processes.

  • Ability to discuss and assess technical trade-offs with engineering teams.

  • Strong experience working directly with customers and managing stakeholder relationships.

  • Comfortable working with demanding customers and maintaining composure under pressure.

  • Demonstrated delivery and project management skills with a high level of ownership.

  • Excellent attention to detail while managing multiple moving parts.

  • Strong communication and negotiation skills, including resetting expectations when necessary.

  • Good judgment: knowing when to push, when to compromise, and when to say no.

  • Willingness to challenge both customers and internal teams constructively.

  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable operating in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.

 

Why Join Us?

 

  • Opportunity to be part of a high-growth, innovative tech start-up

  • Collaborative, mission-driven culture

  • Hands-on experience working on impactful AI products
